build_RandomFlip3D: build a RandomFlip3D pipeline to randomly flip 3D point clouds and bounding boxes horizontally or vertically
build_ObjectSample: build an ObjectSample pipeline to sample GT objects from a database and paste them into the scene
build_GlobalRotScaleTrans: build a GlobalRotScaleTrans pipeline to apply random rotation, scaling, and translation to 3D scenes
build_ObjectNoise: build an ObjectNoise pipeline to apply per-object translation and rotation noise to 3D bounding boxes and points
build_VoxelBasedPointSampler: build a VoxelBasedPointSampler pipeline to voxel-sample points from current and previous LiDAR sweeps
